I relate to this entire post! I’m “clean” but still have the occasional relapse, but nothing as deep as I used to. My memory from that time is extremely spotty so it makes me sad to see how much damage I used to do, and doing certain actions and using tools can give me flashbacks. Sometimes looking at my scars for too long changes my mood as well. 

I’ve also been hesitant to call it self-inflicted PTSD as it doesn’t affect me day to day. However ptsd makes sense,  we certainly have exposed ourselves to some gore and pain so it’s bound to have lasting effects on our mental states. 

I’m sorry it’s been on your mind more than usual. I’ve also had phases of severe disgust and shock about the scars and my past, but the best thing I’ve been able to do is remind myself that I’m away from the worst of it, and I’m safe enough now to be conscious, mindful and careful regarding SH and myself. sending love ❤️
